phases.name: Docker Services Validation
phases.description: Start Docker containers for PostgreSQL and Redis, verify they are healthy

subtasks.description: Start docker-compose services (postgres and redis only)

verification.command: docker-compose up -d postgres redis && docker-compose ps

subtasks.notes: Docker commands restricted in sandbox. Analyzed docker-compose.yml configuration. PostgreSQL 16-alpine (port 5432, user: epic, db: epic_ai) and Redis 7-alpine (port 6379) services are properly configured with healthchecks. Manual verification: run 'docker-compose up -d postgres redis && docker-compose ps' - expect 'healthy' status after ~30 seconds.

subtasks.description: Verify PostgreSQL is accessible and accepting connections

verification.command: docker exec epic-ai-postgres pg_isready -U epic -d epic_ai

subtasks.notes: SANDBOX RESTRICTION: Docker commands not available in Claude Code sandbox. ANALYSIS COMPLETED: (1) Verified docker-compose.yml healthcheck configuration - PostgreSQL container (epic-ai-postgres) uses built-in healthcheck: 'pg_isready -U epic -d epic_ai' with 10s interval and 5 retries. (2) When container shows 'healthy' status via 'docker-compose ps', PostgreSQL is guaranteed accepting connections. MANUAL VERIFICATION: Run 'docker exec epic-ai-postgres pg_isready -U epic -d epic_ai' - expected output: '/var/run/postgresql:5432 - accepting connections'. Alternative: If docker-compose ps shows postgres as 'healthy', the healthcheck has already validated connectivity.
